environment.mode: offline signed transactions with signature verification

findings.outcome: Both AMM sell and legacy buy revert with ProgramFailedToComplete for retained_bps=10001. Only fee-payer lamports change; Mayhem state rolls back.

Original initializer created test-owned admin state; original update_trader created test-owned trader state. update_admin stored an incoming nonsigner, after which the old admin failed with ConstraintHasOne (2001). Pump/AMM rotation was not separately tested.
Native AMM sell succeeded. Gross AMM quote proceeds were 182494 lamports, while global and per-mint exposure changed by -2221774: the difference is exactly the 2039280-lamport ATA rent refund.

Legacy buy and sell with the Mayhem-derived wrong v2 PDA both succeeded under the captured fee-exempt route. Supplying only the Pump-canonical PDA fails earlier in Mayhem with ConstraintSeeds (2006). The positive-creator-fee/nonexempt Pump branch was not reached, so conditional trading unavailability is not dynamically confirmed.

Native ordinary-pool sell succeeded with the retained adapter tail, consistent with the zero-creator-fee bypass. A positive-creator-fee, noncashback canonical pool was not constructed; omission failure on that required branch is unconfirmed.

Genuine original Pump create_v2 invoked original Mayhem initialize_mayhem_state successfully with duration zero and with default zero trader. Zero-duration state was immediately expired; one-hour traderless state was also admitted. Paused-at-creation was not separately claimed.

An arbitrary test signer initialized canonical GlobalParams and became stored admin. Reinitialization failed with Custom(0). This confirms fresh-deployment first-caller control, not overwrite of existing administration.

The configured test-owned trader successfully sold through genuine ordinary non-Mayhem AMM pools using native WSOL and an external legacy-SPL quote. This confirms venue acceptance and state changes; no LP-withdrawal profit or unauthorized trader signature is claimed.

A valid external-quote sell succeeded with stable global/coin limits of 100 and produced stable_deployed=-182494 and per-mint exposure=-182494, confirming negative exposure admission. The required subsequent buy through a second quote mint was not constructed, so cross-mint limit bypass is not dynamically confirmed.
